title: Uruguayan Beef Flank Steak Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring beef flank steak, perfect for a sick day. This dish is rich in fatty acids and anti-inflammatory properties.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the potato, beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 1.5 hours.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry over the pot and trim the edges to fit.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the stew in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
